questions.prompt: When an interrupt arrives, where does the CPU transfer control?
options: To the next instruction of the current program
To the interrupt service routine for that interrupt

questions.prompt: What is the table that holds the addresses of all the interrupt service routines called? (two words)
The interrupt architecture must save the address of the interrupted instruction.
A software-generated interrupt caused by an error or a user request is called a trap or an ______. (one word)
Which of these causes a trap rather than a hardware interrupt?
options: The disk finishes reading a block

questions.prompt: Why is jumping through the interrupt vector fast?
options: The vector is stored on disk
The interrupt number is an index into the table, so the address is found in one step
The CPU searches every service routine until it finds the right one

questions.prompt: An operating system is interrupt driven: with nothing to do, it waits for an interrupt or trap.
A program asks the OS to open a file. What kind of event is that?
options: A hardware interrupt from the disk
A trap caused by a user request (a system call)
